title: The Salt Coast
tests: Noir pressure story, first person past, terse and dry
Three people; the protagonist is at the end of two ties
Groups at the end of ties and holdings (a group tie can be the spotlight)

title: The Orchard Year
tests: Smallest cast: two people, so every chapter has the same cast
Quiet, lingering, melancholic third person: little plot, so a chapter can easily repeat the last
Ten chapters, the shortest run allowed, so chapter 10 is the last chapter and must close the story

title: The Ferry That Was Always Late
tests: Largest cast (five) and longest run (twenty chapters, the most allowed: a long history for the planner and the writer to cut)
Absurd comedy in third person present: tests tense drift and humour without a list of jokes
Many ties from one protagonist, so the spotlight varies; minor characters must stay roles with no names

Eleven chapters
